tasks.title: Evidence Inbox

tasks.title: Case Readiness and Evidence Request List
tasks.acceptance: Every blocker/request traces to actual inventory or declared requirements; readiness never asserts tax correctness; no automatic send.

tasks.title: Review Queue
tasks.acceptance: Counts reconcile to defined categories without hidden double counting; agreements and excluded items remain inspectable.

tasks.title: Finding Lifecycle and Practitioner Notes
tasks.acceptance: Workflow resolution never changes historical machine state; reevaluation creates traceable new machine evidence; notes are attributable.

tasks.title: Workpaper Evidence Bundle
tasks.acceptance: All included facts trace to their origin; notes are distinguishable from machine facts; signed receipt bytes remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Multi-case Workspace
tasks.acceptance: Opening a case cannot show another case’s findings/receipt; readiness displays blockers rather than unsupported certainty.

tasks.title: Versioned Source Adapters
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible acquisition retains lineage and adapter version; changed/unsupported profiles fail visibly; kernel authority unchanged.

tasks.title: Controlled Document Intake
tasks.acceptance: Minimum permissions, explicit destination case and no silent import or send; duplicate/failure handling is traceable.

tasks.title: Firm Mappings and Tax-software Export
tasks.acceptance: Mappings cannot silently expand semantics; exports preserve origin and do not represent tax-law determinations.

tasks.title: Connector Health and Lineage
tasks.acceptance: Partial/failed fetch never reports complete; retry and version changes remain visible without changing prior evidence.

tasks.title: Firm Queue and Maker/Reviewer Controls
tasks.acceptance: Policy routes review without determining tax correctness; unsupported evidence requires declared review; no self-approval bypass where forbidden.

tasks.title: Evidence-request Workflow
tasks.acceptance: Every external send is approved; arrival never silently resolves findings; new evidence passes supported validation.

tasks.title: Change Impact and Reviewer Delta
tasks.acceptance: Delta counts reconcile to stable comparison rules; unchanged findings remain inspectable; historical signed records preserved.

tasks.title: Operational Review Metrics
tasks.acceptance: Definitions/denominators and access boundaries are documented; no taxpayer behavioral analytics; no metrics collection before authorization.

tasks.title: Evidence Classification
tasks.acceptance: Incorrect/unsupported/ambiguous classifications remain reviewable; model cannot silently authorize processing.

tasks.title: Evidence Extraction
tasks.acceptance: Every proposed value locates its source; absent/ambiguous values remain unknown; confirmed data still meets supported validation.

tasks.title: Schema Mapping
tasks.acceptance: No ingestion under an unconfirmed mapping; ambiguous proceeds/basis/date/unit fields require review; no silent parser expansion.

tasks.title: Evidence Gap Assistant
tasks.acceptance: Recommendations cite real unresolved items and never invent missing evidence or decide tax correctness.

tasks.title: Finding Explanation Assistant
tasks.acceptance: Explanation cannot alter numbers/state or hide uncertainty; unsupported explanations are rejected or visibly unavailable.

tasks.title: Evidence-request Drafting
tasks.acceptance: Human approves recipients and content before any sending; drafting alone performs no external action.

tasks.title: Case Summary and Conflict Discovery
tasks.acceptance: Every factual assertion is traceable; contradictions remain proposals and do not declare a source true.

tasks.title: Case Q&A
tasks.acceptance: Numeric/filter questions use declared deterministic queries; case isolation, unsupported-question refusal and exact values are tested.

tasks.title: Assurance API, Receipt SDK and Verifier Ecosystem
tasks.acceptance: External implementations pass declared conformance vectors; API does not delegate assurance authority to AI.

tasks.title: Portable Evidence Graph and Review History
tasks.acceptance: History preserves machine/human/AI distinctions and verifies change lineage without modifying prior signed records.

tasks.title: Enterprise Identity, Policy and Deployment
tasks.acceptance: Tenant isolation, least privilege, recovery and deployment evidence are qualified; firm policy never becomes a tax determination.

tasks.title: Enterprise Connectors and Additional Assurance Domains
tasks.acceptance: Each new domain has an explicit contract, corpus, uncertainty boundary and independent qualification; no inherited claims of correctness.
